basic_info.description: Do not miss this opportunity to own a contemporary two bedroom condo in this vibrant San Francisco location at an absolutely amazing price! Located in Anza Vista, this condo is a short walk to all that NoPa and the Divisadero Corridor have to offer. Walk to restaurants, cafes, nightlife or enjoy time at Alamo Square or the Panhandle! Located at the back of the building this condo offers a quiet oasis to enjoy City living at its finest. The high ceilings and open floor plan create an inviting living space which opens to a sheltered, private patio, ideal for modern indoor/ outdoor living. The efficient kitchen is ideal for the budding chef and opens to the dining area, perfect for entertaining or enjoying a quiet dinner after work. With the fireplace as a central focus of the living room this is a perfect place to relax. The two good sized bedrooms both have large closets and are separated by the full bathroom, maximizing privacy.  Shared laundry is found in the garage. This condo is perfect for a first time home buyer who wants to enjoy all that this hip neighborhood offers. Walk to Che Fico, NOPA, The Mill, Bi-Rite, the local Farmer's Market - so many shopping and dining options. Area is served by multiple buses with easy access to downtown, tech shuttles and 101!
